payout_quote: You are eligible to receive a $50 bonus for each referral who opens a qualifying checking account (up to 10 referrals - total of $500) in a calendar year.
steps: Hold an eligible Chase personal checking account (Total Checking, Premier Plus Checking, Sapphire Checking, or Private Client Checking) - the referral offer appears about 30 days after account opening.
Get your personalized referral link (Copy link button on the official referral page/account).
Share the link with friends - they MUST open their qualifying Chase checking account through your link for you to get credit.
The $50 bonus is deposited into your primary checking account within 30 days after your friend opens the account, as long as neither account is closed or restricted at payout.
catches: Friend must open a qualifying checking account through YOUR personalized link - any other application path earns you nothing.
Cap: 10 referrals / $500 total per calendar year.
Only specific personal checking accounts are eligible (Total, Premier Plus, Sapphire, Private Client); the offer appears roughly 30 days after you open your account.
No bonus if either account is closed or restricted at the time of payout.
JPMorgan Chase employees are not eligible for the program.
Chase does not tell you when a friend opens an account, so tracking your own referrals is on you.
biggest_catch: Your friend MUST apply through your exact personalized link - a referral who opens any other way earns you nothing, and the cap is $500 per calendar year.
eligibility: Eligible Chase personal checking account holders (Total, Premier Plus, Sapphire, Private Client), available about 30 days after account opening.
timing: Bonus deposited within 30 days after the referred friend opens the qualifying account, provided both accounts are open and unrestricted at payout.
